The Pediatric Heart Network z-score coefficients

Source: R/phn_zscore.R
phn_zscore_table.Rd

Returns the coefficients phn_zscore() uses, exactly as published in Table 2 of Lopez et al. (2017): for each structure, its unit, the BSA exponent alpha, and the mean and standard deviation of the indexed value measurement / BSA^alpha, with the echocardiographic view it was measured in or the formula it was derived by.

Usage

phn_zscore_table()

Value

A data.frame with one row per structure (34 rows) and columns structure (the paper's abbreviation), label (the paper's definition), view (Table 2's "Echocardiographic View or Formula"), unit (the unit the mean and SD are in), alpha, mean and sd.

References

Lopez L, Colan S, Stylianou M, et al. Relationship of echocardiographic Z scores adjusted for body surface area to age, sex, race, and ethnicity: the Pediatric Heart Network Normal Echocardiogram Database. Circ Cardiovasc Imaging. 2017;10(11):e006979, Table 2. doi:10.1161/CIRCIMAGING.117.006979

See also

phn_zscore()

Examples

subset(phn_zscore_table(), structure %in% c("ANN", "ROOT", "STJ", "AAO"))
#>    structure                     label                  view unit alpha mean
#> 7        ANN   Aortic annular diameter Parasternal long axis   cm   0.5 1.48
#> 8       ROOT      Aortic root diameter Parasternal long axis   cm   0.5 2.06
#> 9        STJ      Sinotubular junction Parasternal long axis   cm   0.5 1.69
#> 10       AAO Ascending aortic diameter Parasternal long axis   cm   0.5 1.79
#>      sd
#> 7  0.14
#> 8  0.18
#> 9  0.16
#> 10 0.18
